lines.text: Per Weapon mode. Every weapon gets its own anti-recoil.
Other modes pick a category, and switch between two profiles.
Wrong category, wrong setting.
In Per Weapon, every weapon has its own slot. No profile to confuse.
You still need a DualSense, with adaptive triggers on.
Hold L2, release Options. Go to Combat, Weapon Detect, and enable it.
Press Cross. Device stays PS5. Press Down, and set Type to Per Weapon.
A new row appears: Teach Weapon. Leave with Circle. It saves itself.
Fire once. The weapon claims its own slot, automatically.
Known weapons show their real name. Unknown ones become Custom, plus a number.
Too high or too low? Hold L2 and press Up or Down, while firing.
It's permanent, for that exact weapon.
Switch weapons, and the next one has its own values.
Two weapons sharing a signature show a question mark. Press L2 and Right, to switch to the other one.
Totally wrong? Hold L2, Circle and Down, to open your sixty-four slots, and pick.
Weapon missing? Teach it. Open Teach Weapon, and pick a slot.
Fire with the weapon. The screen shows the measured values. Fire two or three times: they should stay the same.
Confirm with Cross, pick its category, then a name if you want.
Saved. Slots even survive a power off, and a re-flash.
To tweak a saved weapon, open its slot, pick a row, and change the value with Left and Right.
Square deletes it. It asks first.
One anti-recoil switch covers all your weapons.
Custom weapon badly tuned mid-fight? Hold Share and Triangle for a second, to fall back to the manual profile.
The full guide is on Rocket Mod dot org.
